page.overview:
What is Azumarill?

Azumarill's physical appearance includes two large, floppy ears. Its blue on the upper half, and white on the lower half. In the middle are white circles of various sizes. Azumarill have short, stubby, blue arms with no fingers. One significant feature is its zigzag tail with a blue ball at the end, which is a trademark to one of Azumarill's pre-evolution, Azurill. When it activates its attacks, the ball sometimes glows. It has excellent hearing. The base of its body looks like an egg to some people.

When Azumarill spots a Pokémon struggling in the water, it creates a balloon of air so that the other Pokémon can breathe.

Azumarill evolves from Marill starting at level 18 and is the final evolution of Azurill.
